kicker: SCION 084 · FRAMING, GESTURE, CITY RHYTHMS & VIDEO ESSAYS
title: Pickpocket — Object Transfer as Dramatic Grammar
subtitle: Close manual relays of keys, sand, glass tubes, cigarettes, and ceremonial exchanges
theorem: Build narrative tension entirely through close-ups of hands approaching, uncovering, transferring, lighting, and locking objects—letting manual contact and release carry the scene rather than facial acting.
boundary_note: Each manual contact shot retains its historical source attribution (1930–2000) while demonstrating Bresson's object-relay grammar.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Chains 6 close manual object transfers and manipulations (`7102b861`, `421addd5`, `aac99422`, `cde56cc9`, `95f7caf3`, `3999cd12`).
